chain.label: Runway 13 contaminated with accumulating snow during a winter storm, closed intermittently for snow removal
chain.trigger: the runway was covered with snow, which was inconsistent with their expectations

chain.label: Captain's situational stress over stopping performance, the snowier-than-expected runway, short runway length, and Flushing Bay off the departure end
chain.trigger: created some situational stress for the captain, who was the pilot flying

caused_by.evidence: The unavailability of braking actions reports and the uncertainty about the runway's condition created some situational stress for the captain

chain.label: Left crosswind component of about 9 knots present at touchdown
chain.trigger: a combination of the 9-knot left crosswind component and asymmetric reverse thrust inputs...induced a left yawing moment

chain.label: Captain applied an aggressive, rapidly-increasing reverse thrust input almost immediately after main gear touchdown
chain.trigger: The captain made a relatively aggressive reverse thrust input almost immediately after touchdown

caused_by.evidence: likely compounded the captain's previous stress...and prompted him to make an aggressive input on the thrust reversers

chain.label: Captain's attention was captured by the airplane's slide and the spoiler-deployment check, preventing him from monitoring rapidly rising EPR
chain.trigger: these factors reduced the captain's monitoring of EPR indications

caused_by.evidence: As reverse thrust EPR was rapidly increasing, the captain's attention was focused on other aspects of the landing

chain.label: Excessive reverse thrust (max 2.07 EPR left, 1.91 EPR right) caused rudder blanking, degrading rudder directional-control effectiveness
chain.trigger: The high EPR values caused rudder blanking...and a subsequent loss of aerodynamic directional control

caused_by.evidence: these factors reduced the captain's monitoring of EPR indications. The high EPR values caused rudder blanking
a combination of the 9-knot left crosswind component and asymmetric reverse thrust inputs...induced a left yawing moment

chain.label: Loss of directional control during landing roll; airplane yawed left to a heading of 114°, 20° off the runway heading
chain.trigger: directional control was regained too late to be effective

caused_by.evidence: the rudder was blanked by the thrust reversers, causing the rudder to be ineffective in controlling the airplane's heading

chain.label: Airplane departed the left side of runway 13 about 3,200 feet from the threshold
chain.trigger: the airplane continued to yaw to the left and departed the left side of runway 13

caused_by.evidence: the airplane's departure from the left side of the runway could not be avoided because directional control was regained too late to be effective
